newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends up on lack of import covering.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends up on lack of import covering.

text.p: Sri Lankan rupee ended higher against the dollar on Monday on a lack of commercial demand for the U.S. unit, dealers said.
The dollar closed at 55.72 rupees after opening at 55.76, dealers said. It ended at 55.78 rupees on Friday.
The Central Bank also pushed down the dollar by 1.25 local cents and set buying and selling rates at 55.3534 and 56.4716, following dollar weakness overseas.
"A lack of import covering kept the dollar under pressure," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer. Overnight call money closed at 15 percent. -- Prithi Kodagoda 941-434319
